sources: KA tyre spec papers 2022-2026 (kb/sources/tyre-spec-pdfs/) + Karting Australia recommended-pressure notice + importer pages; extract: gpt-knowledge/control-tyre-data-extract.md

rise.note: Magnesium rims heat faster and usually show a larger cold-to-hot rise. These rise figures are paddock estimates for the advisor, not a published table.

compoundsNote: Australian control tyres 2022-2026. coldBar = recommended COLD starting window (KA notice / spec paper). The generic windowBar above stays as the fallback for unknown tyres; when a compound is set, judge cold pressures against its window and hot against window + expected rise.
